newsitem.title: UK: Britain sends carrier, frigate to Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Britain sends carrier, frigate to Gulf.

text.p: Britain has sent an aircraft carrier and frigate to the Middle East for exercises in the Gulf, defence officials said on Monday.
The aircraft carrier Invincible and the frigate Sheffield are accompanied by a support ship.

"They are conducting a deployment in the Middle East over the next few weeks and will be visiting several Gulf ports and conducting exercises with several friendly navies in the region," a defence spokesman said.

Nicholas Soames, Minister of State for Armed Forces, was quoted by Gulf newspapers earlier this month as saying while on a visit to the region hat Britain planned to deploy naval forces in the Gulf in coming months to show Iran and Iraq that the United States was not policing the region alone.
He said one of the biggest British naval deployments in the area would be made in February and March.
